title: Elijah Taken Up to Heaven

questions.question: What separated Elijah and Elisha as they walked?
options: Chariots of fire and horses of fire
questions.correctAnswer: Chariots of fire and horses of fire
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 2:11 (ESV): "...behold, chariots of fire and horses of fire separated the two of them..."

questions.question: How did Elijah go up into heaven?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 2:11 (ESV): "...And Elijah went up by a whirlwind into heaven."

questions.question: What did Elisha ask for before Elijah was taken?
options: A double portion of your spirit
questions.correctAnswer: A double portion of your spirit
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 2:9 (ESV): "...Please let there be a double portion of your spirit on me."

questions.question: What did Elisha pick up that fell from Elijah?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 2:13 (ESV): "He also took up the cloak of Elijah that had fallen from him..."

questions.question: What happened to the boys who mocked Elisha?
options: Two she-bears came out of the woods and tore forty-two of them
questions.correctAnswer: Two she-bears came out of the woods and tore forty-two of them
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 2:24 (ESV): "...And two she-bears came out of the woods and tore forty-two of the boys."

questions.question: What cities did Elijah and Elisha visit before crossing the Jordan?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 2:1, 2, 4 (ESV): Mentions Gilgal, Bethel, and Jericho.

questions.question: How did they cross the Jordan?
options: Elijah struck the water with his cloak and it parted
questions.correctAnswer: Elijah struck the water with his cloak and it parted
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 2:8 (ESV): "Then Elijah took his cloak and rolled it up and struck the water... and the two of them went over on dry ground."

questions.question: What did the sons of the prophets at Jericho want to do after Elijah was gone?
options: Send fifty strong men to seek Elijah
questions.correctAnswer: Send fifty strong men to seek Elijah
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 2:16 (ESV): "...Please let them go and seek your master. It may be that the Spirit of the LORD has caught him up and cast him upon some mountain..."

questions.question: What was wrong with the water of Jericho?
options: It was bad and the land was unfruitful
questions.correctAnswer: It was bad and the land was unfruitful
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 2:19 (ESV): "...Behold, the situation of this city is pleasant... but the water is bad, and the land is unfruitful."

questions.question: What did Elisha use to heal the water?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 2:21 (ESV): "He went out to the spring of water and threw salt in it..."

questions.question: What did Elisha say as Elijah was taken up?
options: My father, my father! The chariots of Israel and its horsemen!
questions.correctAnswer: My father, my father! The chariots of Israel and its horsemen!
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 2:12 (ESV): "And Elisha saw it and he cried, 'My father, my father! The chariots of Israel and its horsemen!'"

questions.question: How long did the men search for Elijah?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 2:17 (ESV): "...So they sent fifty men, who sought for three days but did not find him."

questions.question: What did the boys mock Elisha about?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 2:23 (ESV): "...jeered at him, saying, 'Go up, you baldhead! Go up, you baldhead!'"

questions.question: Where did Elisha go after the incident with the bears?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 2:25 (ESV): "From there he went on to Mount Carmel..."

questions.question: Did Elisha want the men to search for Elijah?

key_verse_text: When they had crossed, Elijah said to Elisha, “Ask what I shall do for you, before I am taken from you.” And Elisha said, “Please let there be a double portion of your spirit on me.” (ESV)
